chunks: And by this chain, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) — and he was the oldest leader among the descendants of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) — who said: I saw him between the two mosques, and he was a youth.

key_terms.بَيْنَ الْمَسْجِدَيْنِ: Between the two mosques (referring to Mecca and Medina)
key_terms.وَلَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Descendants of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: Who saw the Imam of the Time between the two mosques and what was his condition at that time?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the lineage of Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, a prominent descendant of the Prophet, who witnessed the Imam of the Time (a.s.) as a youth between the two holy mosques. This account serves as a key evidence for the physical presence and visibility of the Imam during the Minor Occultation, reinforcing the authenticity of the sighting reports within Shia eschatology.
